rules.identity: Create one bounded physical Medium manifestation at actual fitting supported120ft/LoE space. Appearance is shade-like, but it is corporeal: no hover,flight,incorporeal traversal,phylactery,actual dead lich,private identity,soul ownership,legendary actions,CR or elite-asset permission. Original source160baseHP is not an owner HP bank.
rules.repertoire: NEW grant this finite shade only three actual reviewed spell activations: Chill Touch rank0/base0RP, Vampiric Touch rank3/base5RP, Enervation rank5/base10RP. Their full native records and complete accepted procedures/shared rules are embedded below unchanged. This is explicit spell-local acquisition for the shade, not a claim that the owner knows/prepares them or has another class. For Chill Touch preserve the creating-class source placement: Wizard Evocation, Cleric/Druid Necromancy; all deal native necrotic damage. No menu substitution,more spells,scroll casting,metamagic,Overcast,spellbook,scribing,owner discounts or owner class matrices are granted.
rules.fundingAndCadence: Each child spell is genuinely cast by the shade at its attached commanded Action. Before committing, require actual component anatomy,target,rank,shade Dissonance legality and owner available RP. Pay the original owner pool the full child base plus shade strain surcharge and any actual child-source extras, never an owner discount/surcharge/metamagic; owner must still exist with that actually spendable pool. No personal shade RP pool or credit. Shade owns Dissonance/Refrain/lastFamily with ordinary base0/1/1,limit=max(4,2+snapshotPB+max(0,shadeINTmod)); no Wizard first-family exemption, class proc or Arcane Feedback. Failed/countered paid child keeps command/offense,cost and strain; a known unfundable attempt creates no cast and its issued command expires in that phase. Owner has no second cast/cadence/hit/heal/kill event. Recasting a genuinely new shade costs the full parent21RP and ends old parent/child; it creates a finite new shade cadence record only, never refunds ownerRP,used owner round allowance,world assets or existing persistent riders.
rules.childConcentration: Owner owns parent concentration; shade separately owns at most one child concentration. Casting Enervation starts shade concentration at child commitment, ending an old child before counters/outcome, never owner parent. Vampiric Touch is the exact instantaneous3d6 touch spell, not an invented concentration repeat attack. Chill Touch is actual Touch,not a ranged imported card. Enervation is actual60ft ranged4d8 pulse,60second channel,max10pulses; follow-up maintenance consumes a later real BA command plus the shade single attached Action and shared offense allowance, but no new RP/cast/Refrain. No spare owner Action or extra turn buys pulses. Own regular virtual cycle is original owner attached opportunity; if a future cycle receives no legal maintenance, end at its attached END. Loss of actual target continuity/range/perception/LoE,shade Incapacitated,death/ending,or full suppression ends channel immediately under its native source. Damage to shade tests its own child concentration with CONsave versus max(10,floor(damage/2)); damage to owner tests parent only. Parent ending removes shade and ends child before any later checkpoint. No orphaned beam/missed pulse replay.
rules.spellOwnership: Shade is actual caster/dealer/heal recipient. Each actual Enervation initial/maintenance attack creates a NEW damage root sampling the shade then-current Veil; subsequent pulses do not inherit an earlier attack root. The owner Veil is irrelevant. Genuine damage transfers preserve that root; healing sums only allowed terminal branches once,including actual tempHP absorbed where native Vampiric Touch/Enervation permit it,excluding overkill,no-derived-heal/no-recovery branches and duplicates. Do not graft the narrower native Drain filter onto these spells. Full damage/life/source-ending consequences precede healing; ended shade is not recreated. Child spell-specific independent timed riders, notably Chill Touch, keep their own endpoint after parent ending unless their own source requires caster persistence; this is not orphaned concentration or a stored pulse. No shade Reaction,Counterspell,Ready,spell copy or owner personal hook is granted.
rules.drain: NEW alternative native commanded melee Action against one actual enemy creature within5ft/legal reach/perception/LoE: use shade snapshot spellattack; hit2d8necrotic,no modifier,crit4d8. Actual hostility is ordinary scene knowledge, not faction truth detection. After damage and source-ending callbacks, if the same shade remains, heal it floor(eligible actual normalHP lost/2) once under real ordinary healing rules. TemporaryHP loss,overkill,prevented loss and no-recovery/no-derived-healing branches contribute0. Exclude friendly willing batteries,temporary summons/copies/resource-prohibited creations and consumed animated stock from funding; their actual damage eligibility remains separate. No owner healing,RP,maxHP theft or imported class Life Drain. A miss/zero eligible loss/blocked heal creates no reserve or refund. This explicit native drain differs from the unchanged child spells.

operational.targets: One creature you perceive and can physically touch within your actual legal reach, with line of effect. The 5-foot reference describes ordinary Touch reach; no extended reach is granted. Use the actual Evocation or Necromancy placement available to the chosen class; access is not unioned.
operational.duration: Instantaneous damage; one target-round broad current-HP-gain prohibition, no concentration. The rider ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding its entire current turn if already underway. Outside initiative it ends six elapsed seconds after application. Preserve the original regular/virtual marker or outside absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and travel; end-phase events precede expiry cleanup.
operational.resolution: Make one melee spell attack. Miss: no damage or restriction. Hit: deal 1d8 necrotic and establish the independent HP-gain prohibition under its actual defenses.
operational.effect: While affected, any event increasing the target’s current HP produces 0 gain: spell/feature/potion healing, passive regeneration, natural recovery, natural-20 death-save 1HP, Stable-state 1HP and other direct restoration. Apply HEALING_DEATH_PLAYTEST.md: ordinary healing’s legal amount and genuine excess become0; ordinary activation costs remain committed, while a reserve spent only for actual restored HP spends0. Independent non-HP components still resolve. A blocked natural20 uses the already-reviewed bridge: Stable at0, death counters cleared, immediate d4-hour recovery deadline and preserved used-turn marker. A due Stable1HP recovery remains subject to its existing blocked-deadline procedure; this spell never rerolls or resets that deadline.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, target count, duration, uses or magnitude.
operational.limitations: No Undead/biological target prerequisite or special Undead rider. The prohibition does not itself block stabilization, successful death-save state changes, temporary HP, condition removal, damage prevention, maximum-HP changes or independent non-HP components. completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Action,one perceived creature60feet,4d8necrotic per round and heal half. NEW reconcile Core Instantaneous with a concentration channel lasting at most60seconds, with one initial pulse during the casting Action and at most nine further pulses, never more than ten total. The initial pulse makes a ranged spell attack against the declared creature using the real casting source; hit deals4d8necrotic (ordinary attack critical applies), miss deals none. Only one original target exists; no retarget. At each future regular caster turn an Action may maintain one further pulse against that same still-existing original creature target, with perception/range60/line of effect rechecked. At most one pulse per original regular caster-turn cycle; extra turns/Actions grant none. If no maintenance Action is completed during an available future regular turn, the channel ends at that turn's END; a miss still counts as maintenance. Outside initiative an otherwise capable caster spends the equivalent whole Action at each successive six-second cycle; missed maintenance ends it. Loss of concentration, actual caster incapacity, target death, actual separation beyond60feet, loss of line of effect/perception, removal or expiry ends the channel immediately; suppression makes a pulse unavailable, consumes its scheduled opportunity and therefore causes missed-maintenance ending if it spans the entire relevant turn/cycle. No paused beam or stored future pulse exists. A hit's healing resolves after its damage/life consequences, even if that hit killed the target and thereby ended later pulses: caster receives ordinary base healing floor(actualDamageDealt/2), using this pulse's eligible terminal branches once and excluding duplicated parents, overkill and copied/replayed descendants. Do not halve nominal dice before counting actual damage or require ordinary HP loss when tempHP was truly absorbed. Damage transfer remains one root; sum its actual terminal recipients without healing separately for each. Apply genuine ordinary healing modifiers, broad prohibition, current maximum/Critical ceiling and source causal guards. Full casterHP, blocked healing or a miss stores nothing and refunds nothing. Unlike Lifedraw's expressly narrower profile, this proposal adds no living-nonconstruct/allied/helpless exclusion to the printed damage and heal clause; necrotic defenses still govern actual numbers. Damage/HP cannot be farmed from an invented summon resource pool or overkill. A subsequent paid cast begins a genuinely new channel and concentration, not a free same-channel extra pulse; all real Action/RP/Dissonance costs apply. The proposal's ten-pulse ceiling and continuous maintenance are NEW balance choices for joint review.

CURRENT HEALING-ELIGIBILITY COMPLETION: Exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flags forbid derived healing or recovery before summing the base-healing pool. The original NE5-06-B arithmetic is conditional on a genuinely permitted split, not a claim that Burden Shared or Life Linked allows it. The two supplied source-qualified vectors show their actual narrower results and retain the original abstract scenario unchanged. Neither vector changes the separate pending broad donor predicate for this spell.

CURRENT TARGET-CONTINUITY COMPLETION — Enervation only: "Still-existing original creature" is the target identity/lifecycle predicate, not a new living-anatomy or nonconstruct restriction. A continuing active creature classified as nonliving is not excluded solely by that classification. Its actual defenses, damage/source eligibility and no-resource/no-recovery flags still apply to each packet and any healing funding. A corpse, removed body, ended summon or destroyed entity that no longer qualifies as a creature cannot supply a maintained target. A same identity at 0 HP is tested under its actual continuing-creature/Disabled/death state, not assumed dead or alive from the HP number. The attack that actually ends the target finishes its own causal damage and source-qualified healing before future channel opportunities are canceled. This completion does not import Leeching Plague's hostile-living-nonconstruct donor filter, provide healing to a dead caster, or grant repair, resurrection, resource farming or an exception to another source's exclusion flags.
